verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail lets users write custom Auto Labels as short AI prompts that run on incoming mail the moment it arrives, so user-defined event rules exist. The documented action is limited to labeling and routing into split-inbox tabs, and custom labels are restricted to Business and Enterprise plans. Auto Archive covers only built-in categories, and the 'agents… based on triggers you set' claim appears on a suite-wide what's-new page without being tied to Mail. Missing for 10: user-defined rules with arbitrary actions (archive, reply, forward) on custom triggers, Mail-specific documentation of the trigger-based agent builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can even make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts like "job applications" or "requests to review work".
